codesFaq.question: How do I redeem codes?
codesFaq.answer: Open the game, click the settings gear in the top-right, paste your code into the Redeem Code field, and confirm. Codes are case-sensitive.

codesFaq.question: Why do codes stop working?
codesFaq.answer: Codes expire on a schedule set by the developer (usually monthly or tied to update milestones), and some are one-per-account. This page is re-tested regularly.

codesFaq.question: How often are new codes released?
codesFaq.answer: New codes typically arrive with each major game update. Bookmark this page and check back after every patch.

codesFaq.question: Do codes expire?
codesFaq.answer: Yes — most codes have an expiry date, shown next to each code. Expired codes move to the expired table below.

faq.description: Answers to common Zombies Aren't Real questions about gameplay, safe zones, evacuation, maps, multiplayer, and the game's platform.

items.question: What is Zombies Aren't Real?
items.answer: It is a horde-defense strategy game by Jogamedev. You command military forces over real-world city maps, contain an expanding zombie outbreak, and try to save as many civilians as possible.

items.question: Is Zombies Aren't Real multiplayer?
items.answer: Yes. The Steam version supports online co-op with one other player, as well as single-player.

items.question: Does the game support custom maps?
items.answer: Yes. The game includes a level editor and Steam Workshop support for sharing and playing custom maps.

items.question: How do you win a scenario?
items.answer: Eliminate all zombies to win. The number of civilians saved determines your score, so protecting people matters alongside stopping the outbreak.

items.question: What is an evacuation corridor?
items.answer: An evacuation corridor is a directional route used to guide civilians toward safety. Placement and pathfinding can change during Early Access, so check how civilians use the route in your current build.

items.question: What are safe zones for?
items.answer: Safe zones and gates are defensive tools for protecting civilians. Plan the perimeter with its entrances and the soldiers covering its exposed approaches in mind.

items.question: Is this the official game website?
items.answer: No. This is an independent fan-made wiki. Jogamedev develops the game; the official Steam page is linked throughout this site.
